parameters.name: ExpectedRenewDay
parameters.description:
The unified expiration date. After you specify this parameter, the price for renewing the instance to the unified expiration date is queried. Valid values: 1 to 28.

For more information about the unified expiration date feature, see [Synchronize the expiration dates of instances](~~108486~~).

> The renewal duration parameters (Period and PeriodUnit) and the unified expiration date parameter (ExpectedRenewDay) cannot be set at the same time.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The renewal duration. Valid values:

- When PriceUnit is set to Month: 1 to 9.
- When PriceUnit is set to Year: 1 to 3.

Default value: 1.

> The renewal duration parameters (Period and PeriodUnit) and the unified expiration date parameter (ExpectedRenewDay) cannot be set at the same time.

parameters.name: PriceUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the renewal duration. Valid values:

- Month: The renewal duration is measured in months.
- Year: The renewal duration is measured in years.

Default value: Month.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource whose renewal price you want to query. When ResourceType is set to instance, ResourceId is equivalent to InstanceId.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource whose renewal price you want to query. Valid values: instance.

Default value: instance.
